Adding 26 tablets (batch B007-HC002, expires in 718 days) to that run costs ₹60 in picking and handling rather than a second ₹868 vehicle, and averts an expected 26.0 tablets of unmet demand, though the shelf stays short enough that the stock-out risk remains 100%.

orders.rationale: CHC Siwan-02 needs 326 tablets of Pantoprazole and a vehicle is already going there from PHC Saran-01 with other stock. Adding 150 tablets (2 batches: B011-HC001 (77 tablets, 556 days), B012-HC001 (73 tablets, 664 days)) to that run costs ₹60 in picking and handling rather than a second ₹1,462 vehicle, and averts an expected 150.0 tablets of unmet demand, though the shelf stays short enough that the stock-out risk remains 100%.
